note: Inyo County campground strung along Taboose Creek in the sagebrush of the Owens Valley below the Sierra, 14 miles north of Independence and 2 miles west of US 395, with sites on both sides of Tinnemaha Road. Pay stations take cards or cash. Expect strong Eastern Sierra winds. --Claude
summary: Inyo County page + map + ReserveAmerica (headless) read. $14 (+$5 vehicle), no hookups, vault toilets, well water confirmed; added 6 people, no showers, ReserveAmerica booking with some FCFS, year-round (RA), 36 sites, lengths to 60 ft (sites 1-20). Creekside kept.
flags: WATERFRONT: creekside kept. County map puts every site along Taboose Creek; on Esri the campground spurs/clearings on both banks (e.g. ~36.9978,-118.2551 west of Tinnemaha Rd and ~36.9976,-118.2535 east of it) sit ~10-20 m from the creek's willow band over open sagebrush ground; the creek is a few metres wide. Sites are sold by the night on ReserveAmerica (and some FCFS); RA does not tag water proximity, so no single site number is pinned to a measured distance beyond the map's layout (sites 1-17 west, 25-36 east, all creek-side). Not an --AWH value.
